title: Document types
no_workspace: Open a workspace to see its document types.
about: Define a document type once — its template, the sections it must contain, and the rules that make it valid. Every project in the workspace inherits it, so its documents can be checked against the same requirements.
analyser_unknown: Could not read the analyser's vocabulary
template_only_hint: The analyser accepts {accepted} — documents of this type can still be templated and validated, but purpose and leak will refuse them
pick_one: Pick a type above to view or override it, or create a new one.
pick_one_hint: Saving always writes a workspace-owned type — overriding a built-in of the same key — and every project inherits it.
panel_template_sub: the markdown skeleton a new document starts from
panel_sections_sub: headings a conforming document must contain
panel_rules_sub: what makes a document pass or fail
conforms_when: In a project, a document of this type conforms when:
check_min_words: each section meets its minimum length
check_title_one: the title has at least {count} word
check_title_many: the title has at least {count} words
check_unknown: sections outside the checklist are flagged
save_note: Saved as a workspace type — inherited by every project.
